name: RustGPT_Bench_selected
description: A curated suite of Rust programming problems designed to evaluate code-generation models on Rust-specific tasks. Measures the correctness, compilability, and functional behavior of generated Rust code across curated examples, often via test execution. Useful for assessing language models' ability to produce correct, idiomatic Rust.
evaluation_method: pass@k (functional correctness via compilation and unit-test execution)
reputation: Niche benchmark focused on Rust code generation with modest adoption compared to larger, language-agnostic code benchmarks.
